title: REQ · Contribution service validates prompt, world, round status, limits, rate and spam
summary: The service rejects invalid submissions before anything is written.
description: Context: no contribution logic exists. Desired behavior: Service.Submit validates prompt length, world existence, OPEN round, per-player limit of 5, request rate and duplicate/spam prompts using an injected clock. Expected result: typed errors per rule. Why: protect the Git-backed record from abuse.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prompt shorter than MinPromptLen or longer than MaxPromptLen, when Submit runs, then ErrPromptLength is returned
Given a world with no round source entry, when Submit runs, then ErrWorldNotFound is returned
Given a round whose status is not OPEN, when Submit runs, then ErrRoundNotOpen is returned
Given a player with 5 stored contributions in the round, when Submit runs, then ErrLimitReached is returned
Given more than RateMax submissions in RateWindow by one player, when Submit runs, then ErrRateLimited is returned
Given a prompt identical (case/whitespace-insensitive) to the player's earlier one or containing 10+ repeated identical characters, when Submit runs, then ErrDuplicate or ErrSpam is returned

in_scope: The service rejects invalid submissions before anything is written.
preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
